soldier: Soldier head pale yellowish brown, mandibles reddish brown and slightly transparent, the pilosity of the head capsule sparse. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.57–0.59, the sides parallel, the posterior margin slightly evenly rounded. The frontal ridge is slightly raised, the interfrontal area almost flat. The labrum is sharply spear-shaped, the semi-transparent apical region projecting at an acute angle, bearing apical hairs, the subapical and lateral-apical hairs rather fine and short. The mandibles are short and stout, their apices rather curved with the curved part quite short; the mandibular length about 0.48–0.50 times the head capsule length and about 0.83–0.88 times the head width. Antennae with 15–17 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies at about the anterior one-fifth, the anterolateral margins expanding trapezoidally behind, the middle rather concave, the waist region rather broad with the sides slightly arcuate, the waist constriction index 0.36–0.42. The pronotum is nearly trapezoidal, about 1.56–1.61 times as wide as long, the median notches of the anterior and posterior margins both rather shallow, with nearly ten fine hairs in the middle region.
